# Iconic Beauty & Baby

> Iconic Beauty & Baby is a Sri Lankan beauty and baby store, trading as Iconic Beauty and Baby (PVT) LTD, at No 118, Justice Akbar Mawatha, Colombo 02, Sri Lanka.

## What this site covers
- 798 products and 878 SKUs across 129 brands.
- Categories: skin care, hair care, makeup, fragrance, body and bath, baby and mother, accessories and jewellery, wellness, and gifts and home.
- Prices are in Sri Lankan rupees (LKR) and are built from the current stock report.
- A small set of launch offers shows the selling price with the regular price struck through.
- Checkout, accounts, reviews and orders are browser-only demos. No payment is taken and no order is sent to a server.

## Editorial and data notes
- Product names, SKUs, prices and stock come from the current stock report.
- We do not publish invented reviews, ratings, awards or certifications.
- Product ingredients, directions and warnings should always be checked on the pack.
- The demo does not take payment or ship goods.
